text: That night: the baboon darts out of the laurel bushes
why: ¶222 describes a creature darting from the laurel bushes during the night watch, and ¶225 has Holmes identify it as the baboon. The baboon was already introduced in ¶27 and ¶166.

text: That night: Holmes murmurs that it is the baboon
why: ¶224-225 state directly that Holmes murmurs to Watson, "That is the baboon." The night timing follows from ¶219-222.
